institution: ESMUC — Escola Superior de Música de Catalunya, Barcelona (public conservatory, Generalitat de Catalunya)
programme_name: Màster propi de Composició amb Tecnologies / Master's Degree in Composition with Technologies
official_status: màster propi (ESMUC's own title) — explicitly listed by ESMUC under 'Màster propi', NOT among its official Enseñanzas Artísticas masters, and not in RUCT (conservatory sector is outside RUCT anyway)
start_date_verbatim: Start date: October 1 — academic year running 1 October to 1 June, with the final project submitted in the first week of July
other_intakes: none. THE TRAP IS HERE: ESMUC publishes three preinscripció rounds for 2026-27 — 1st round 2 February–25 March, 2nd round 4 May–24 May, 3rd round 6 July–6 September — but all three feed the SAME single 1 October cohort. The February round is an application window, not a February start.
application_deadline_for_spring_intake: N/A — no spring cohort. (Application rounds for the October 2027 cohort: 1st 2 Feb–25 Mar, 2nd 4 May–24 May, 3rd 6 Jul–6 Sep, dates as published for 2026-27.)
modality: presencial, Monday to Friday 18:30–20:30, attendance required
language_of_instruction: English (as stated on the ESMUC page)
tuition_total_eur: EUR 5,667 = 94.45 EUR/credit x 60 ECTS (rate as published on the page; year of rates not stated on page — treat as 2026-27)
evidence_verbatim: Start date: October 1 ... Pre-enrollment 2026-2027: 1st round February 2 - March 25; 2nd round May 4 - May 24; 3rd round July 6 - September 6
notes: 60 ECTS — a full master's length, not a short course. 15 places. Being a màster propi it gives no PhD access and is normally ineligible for public scholarships. Arithmetic for tuition: 94.45 x 60 = 5,667.

(Los plazos de preinscripción se sitúan alrededor de febrero a junio de cada año para cada curso académico. El periodo lectivo comienza en septiembre).
notes: 60 ECTS, 1 año de duración ('los objetivos específicos que se desarrollarán en el Máster, de 60 ECTS (1 año de duración)'). This is the clearest published statement in the whole slice that multiple convocatorias do NOT mean multiple starts: UPM prints four application rounds and then says in the same breath that teaching begins in September. It also qualifies the institution-wide 'UPM February second-semester' note recorded elsewhere in this sweep — the second cuatrimestre exists in the calendar, but there is no February admission for this title. Note also ETSIST hosts the doctoral programme 'Música y su Ciencia y Tecnología (DMCT)', relevant to path A at PhD level.
